text:
Avery: Who's up for a lazy river paddle or gonna sleep in this weekend? :kayak: :zzz:
Samir: Ooo paddle if it stays dry. What time were you thinking?
Maya: Early for me — 8am at Pier 9 works? low tide might help the current.
Jon: 8 is brutal but I can do it if there's coffee after :coffee:
Priya: I'm leaning sleep-in but I can swing by for bagels at 9:30.
Lilia: Count me in for the bagels-only crew :bagel: (kayak skills 0/10)
Avery: Plan: meet 8 at Pier 9, paddle ~90min, back for bagels ~9:45. I'll bring a cooler + extra water.
Samir: Do we have extra life jackets? I can bring one or two.
Jon: I have 2 jackets and a pump. Also a tiny Bluetooth speaker if anyone wants tunes.
Priya: Bringing bagels — any GF or vegan needs?
Maya: I'll bring GF chia muffins. Also happy to tow a kayak if anyone needs a hand.
opsbot: Reminder: please fill the weekend trip form if you're joining: https://redwood.internal/trips (safety rec)
Avery: @Samir AMAZING, and @Priya TA for bagels :heart:
Samir: If it looks rainy on Saturday morning, fallback plan = movie + brunch at 11? :popcorn:
Lilia: If rain, I vote boardgame cafe instead (less sticky seating).
Jon: Either fallback works. I'll check the radar Friday evening and post an update here.
Maya: If anyone needs a ride to Pier 9 I have room for two in my hatchback. DM me.
Priya: DM'd you @Maya. Thanks!
Avery: Sweet — see y'all Saturday. Quick note: bring sunscreen, and label your stuff. :sunscreen:
Samir: (reacted with :thumbsup:)
Jon: (reacted with :coffee:)
Lilia: Bringing spare hand warmers just in case.
Priya: Bagels will include plain, sesame, and an oat GF option.
Avery: Perfect — weekend vibes locked. :sun_with_face:
